subject: tr-info
title: TR.INFO.------ACT.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 63 (WAM-5). TR-INFO (trans-information) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; ACT (activism) is the partner. From the subject: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) and ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism). From SPT-DY: MOT-DYM. From ACC-FT: POL-DY (political dynamics) and MT-INFO (multi-information). From POL-DY: DEC (decentralization). From DEC: EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics). From MT-INFO: FUND-DYM (fundamental dynamics).
